corpus_adaptation_note: Production ChromaDB (raceintel_knowledge, 503 docs) contains only 24 race_report and 479 driver_report documents and no standalone F1 technical/regulation documents. Consequently, the recommended 10 General F1 explanatory/document questions are adapted to 7 document-grounded race narrative/metadata RAG questions verifiable against ChromaDB, while 3 missing-technical-document probes (undercut strategy, Ferrari upgrades, pit stop duration) are placed in unsupported_or_unanswerable (8 total) to test calibrated abstention without inventing unsupported gold answers.
